caption: Microservices won't fix a tangled codebase. Three myths I see teams fall for before they split the monolith.

slides.say: If your monolith is a mess, splitting it into services usually gives you a distributed mess.
Reality: if services share a database or deploy together, they are still one system. Just slower to change.
Reality: every network call adds latency, retries and failure modes. Small teams often move slower, not faster.

slides.screen: Myth 3: You must split to scale
slides.say: Reality: a modular monolith with clear boundaries scales far further than most products ever need.
Draw clean modules inside one codebase. Split only when a team or workload truly needs it. Follow for more.
